name: glm-conductor
description: Dual-axis selective routing orchestration plugin for GLM coding agents: the GLM-5.3 main session acts as the single architect, declaring solo/delegate/audit/full routes along two independent axes (Delegability × Assurance); GLM-5.3-Flash executors deliver standard and visual implementation while fresh-context read-only reviewers provide independent final audits. Mechanical execution assurance is built in — a four-fold Stop-gate completion check with fingerprint-bound receipts — as is quota-aware continuity (account-level global quota clock that keeps quota windows rolling across resets, precise wake bridging, and a task-side window consumption ledger), so long tasks can resume across sessions.
